assessment_basis: Static review of the repository README and linked feature, architecture or roadmap documentation. Source-level deep audit and CI/test rerun were not performed for this adoption.

evidence.claim: The feature matrix documents bounded CPU, benchmark, source-review, memory, metrics, embedded-C and QCS capabilities with a versioned C ABI.
The CLI, Win32 GUI, C11 core, safety layer, TRACE and tests are described as an integrated local workflow.

limitations: Catalogue counts are inventories, not certification or proof of every listed capability.
No test or CI workflow was re-run during ladder adoption.
next_gate: Run the declared C11 core and ABI target/compiler matrix in CI.
Preserve bounded behavior with boundary, failure and ABI compatibility tests on each supported target.
Record repeatable performance baselines with workload, hardware and measurement method.
